Numerical tests are supplemental only.

value.rationale: The object is a natural minimally sampled exact-degree spherical-harmonic interpolation problem on one regular latitude ring. The exact globally best squared condition number and unique sensor-height design provide a meaningful stability invariant, simultaneously for all N >= 9, with a nontrivial five-mode minimax and precise distinction from harmonic-index moment designs. It is not merely an arbitrary finite computation or a restatement of degree-two paired-ring analysis.
